sources.title: German Empire European geographic terrain reference
sources.publisher: Copernicus / ESA / Airbus; ESA WorldCover consortium

access_metadata.dem_type: DSM includes surface objects, not bare-earth DTM
access_metadata.sampling: GLO90 native 3-arcsecond latitude, variable longitude; averaged 6-arcsecond extraction, 1/512-degree display. Cover 16x categorical overview.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern reference, not 1900 environmental facts. Geographic collars, no ownership mask.
access_metadata.shared_france: Same DSM, metric gradients and mip generator; full French cores not duplicated. Existing French material takes precedence where valid.
